notes: Fable with_skill: 12/12 again — held perfect across iter2→iter3 while absorbing 4 new instructions (backward-designed quiz, why→what→how→check flow, no ascii-art, explicit omission note).

Haiku with_skill: 7/12 (iter2: 5/12). Improvements: eval-1 now has toy data + comprehension quiz (was surface recall). Remaining Haiku failures: still skips pipeline-context exploration, still applies full ritual+quiz to the trivial chore commit, and one quiz answer was factually wrong.
Haiku eval-1 run had to be re-executed (first agent finished without saving output).

Recommendation: converged for the session model. Haiku's residual failures are effort/exploration deficits, not instruction ambiguity — further SKILL.md hardening risks degrading Fable prose quality for marginal Haiku gains.
